# pantechdynamics_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up one existing Pantech DNS zone by id or name (such as "example.com"), to add records to it without managing the zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an existing zone up by name (or by id), to add records to it.
data "pantechdynamics_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "pantechdynamics_dns_record" "api" {
  zone_id = data.pantechdynamics_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "api"
  type    = "CNAME"
  values  = ["lb.example.net"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the DNS zone to look up, starting with dnsz_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the DNS zone to look up. It must match exactly. Names are unique in the account. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the zone was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `description` (String) The zone's description.
- `domain_id` (String) Id of the Pantech domain delegated to the zone, or null.
- `name_servers` (List of String) The Pantech DNS name servers that serve the zone.
- `record_count` (Number) How many record sets the zone holds.
- `status` (String) State of the zone, for example "awaiting_delegation" or "active".
